description: Comptages routiers à la station sur Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Cette couche de données, disponible uniquement sur le portail des données géographiques, permet de consulter des statistiques issues des stations de comptage routier sur Rennes Métropole. /!\ Ces données ont une composante "temps" qui rend difficile leur exploitation en-dehors du Portail de données géographiques de Rennes Métropole. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are trafic, vitesse, trafic routier. The portal shows 15,179 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-09-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
